### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **22** documentable anchor(s).

**35** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0b6956490a1697bf6d5f3cda468d2ee3dd37d786`.

⛔ **12** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **45** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0b6956490a1697bf6d5f3cda468d2ee3dd37d786` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `690891272e0658bad59b58b2228616f6b388529a` — the merge of head `a2ef81b41b6b39b25e4316452d93da51e6794e7f` into base `0b6956490a1697bf6d5f3cda468d2ee3dd37d786`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 690891272e0658bad59b58b2228616f6b388529a && git checkout 690891272e0658bad59b58b2228616f6b388529a
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0b6956490a1697bf6d5f3cda468d2ee3dd37d786 a2ef81b41b6b39b25e4316452d93da51e6794e7f && git checkout -B drift-repro 0b6956490a1697bf6d5f3cda468d2ee3dd37d786 && git merge --no-ff a2ef81b41b6b39b25e4316452d93da51e6794e7f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0b6956490a1697bf6d5f3cda468d2ee3dd37d786
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0b6956490a1697bf6d5f3cda468d2ee3dd37d786` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · #23858 (`Part of`) · `domain:cli` seat 2 · `os-tesla` · session `session_018t6a5rvqPRvEDMCVVW9kYT` · 2026-10-16T15:57Z · reviewed head `a2ef81b41b`, against GitHub and the branch, not against the report's prose. Holder of claim `6215742630`; report `6218946925` on #23858.

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, assignee `os-tesla`. Line 1 is `Part of #23858`, because `serve.ts` `:978` is held off for seat 1's #23743, as the claim ordered. The body has no closing keyword. 21 files, +865 / −32. `check-governed-merges --pr 23979`: NOT governed (0 of 21 paths). `git merge-tree` is clean against `origin/main`.
2. **The walk, read in the diff.** `makeDirectorySync` is one module-internal function per package (`packages/cli/src/utils/make-directory.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/make-directory.ts`). The two bodies are the same logic in each package's indentation. On neither package's entry: the runtime's `src/index.ts` names neither.
   - It finds the nearest existing level by `statSync` and refuses any error other than `ENOENT` at once.
   - It then makes the missing levels top down with a non-recursive `mkdirSync`. An `ENOENT` from `/proc/<missing>` therefore throws at once instead of looping.
   - It accepts `EEXIST` only where a directory stands, so a file in the way still refuses (`EEXIST` / `ENOTDIR`).
   - It returns the first created level, as the recursive form does.
3. **The sites, read in the diff.**
   - `start.ts` `:189` / `:658`, `default-host.ts`, `package-state-store.ts` and `artifact-reference.ts`, plus `compile`, `create`, `generate`, `i18n extract`, `init`, `plugin build`, `auth-config` and `cloud-config`, swap `mkdirSync(…, { recursive: true })` (or the async `mkdir`) for the walk.
   - The PR body classifies all 23 sites. 17 are in scope (16 bounded here, `serve.ts` `:978` held off) and 6 are out by construction, each with its reason.
4. **Measured at the door,** base against branch. `OS_HOME=/proc/os-23858-home os start` went from a hang (168,465 failing `mkdir` in 20 s) to exit 1 in 4.2 s, naming the path and `ENOENT`. The creatable control still reaches "Server is ready". `os serve` empty boot, `os serve` with an http `OS_ARTIFACT_URL`, `os create --dir` and `os init` under `/proc` each go from a hang to exit 1 in about 4 s.
5. **Pins and ablation.**
   - Three pin files, each in bounded children: the CLI door pin (4 cases, 6.37 s), the CLI unit pin (6) and the runtime pin (8, 3.82 s).
   - One ablation put the recursive form back in both helpers. The door pin's two `/proc` legs and both helper pins then hit their bounds and were killed, while the controls stayed green. The restore was proven by blob and by a `dist` marker-absent check.
6. **Changeset, sentence by sentence.** `patch` for `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/runtime`, with `Clause-②: no`: a hang becomes an immediate refusal on paths that could never be created, so no input that succeeds today is refused. No new error code and no export.
7. **Contract review:** none is owed. The paths decide no face, and `Clause-②: no` carries no arm. This seat's read is the review.
8. **Cross-lane, declared before this ACCEPT:** `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs` (one population row, nine → ten, with its reason line) on `domain:spec`'s post (`6218991262`).
9. **Gates, pinned to the head.** Check-runs on `a2ef81b41b` read at this stamp, latest run per name: 41 names, 35 `success`, 6 `skipped`, 0 failure, nothing running. The successes include Build Core, Test Core 1–6/6 (the CLI integration tier and the runtime `test:repo` run there), `Scaffold outside the monorepo`, `TypeScript Type Check` and the four `Type Check ·` lanes, all eight `Lint ·` lanes, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Check Changeset` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard`. The 6 skips are roster names: Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke, Temporal Conformance. The dev's local subset at this head: 87 of 87 derived gate commands exit 0 (`--ran`: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). The runtime local project exits 0 (6130 passed). The CLI unit tier: 302 / 304 files passed on `d188c036d`; the 2 files that pinned the replaced call were fixed in `a2ef81b41` and re-run green. Both typechecks exit 0.
10. **Accepted deviations:**
    - the gate's population row, declared above;
    - two existing CLI tests edited because they pinned the replaced call (`remote-api-utils.test.ts`, `validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`);
    - one merge of `origin/main`, which brought one new site (`dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.ts` `:128`, classified out by construction);
    - the full CLI unit tier not re-run after the two-test fix (declared narrowing);
    - the container restart, with every unrecorded step re-run under the lock.

**Seat ruling on `open_questions[0]` (one shared helper behind a new export): A.** There is no new export. The walk stays one module-internal function per package. The real-need axis and the startup-scope axis both point there: no consumer outside these three packages asks for an fs helper, and an export of `@objectstack/types/node` would widen a published surface without pull. The two in-package copies (`standalone-stack.ts` `makeSqliteDatabaseDirectory`, `dev.ts` `prepareDevDatabaseDirectory`) fold onto each package's `make-directory.ts` in the follow-up that carries `serve.ts` `:978` after #23743. That leaves three internal definitions with one semantics and no contract to version.

**Carried by this seat on #23858, which stays open:** `serve.ts` `:978` (measured hanging: 2,019,800 failing `mkdir` in 45 s), after seat 1's #23743 lands, together with the two in-package folds. 承接者:无: the #23851 / #23696 copies accept any `EEXIST` on a created level, so a dangling symlink there reads as made; the later SQLite open still refuses, and there is no hang.
